apimart.title: APIMart image studio
apimart.intro: Create, edit and refine with GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6. Follow every task from submission to download.
apimart.modelHint: Standard models use token billing. Ext models use per-image billing and have different controls.
apimart.availability26: APIMart has published 2.6 API documentation, while its product announcement still marks availability as pending. Your configured channel may not yet support it.
apimart.ext26Limit: Ext 2.6 currently supports 1K and one output per task.
apimart.sizeHint: Use multiples of 16, edges up to 3840, ratio up to 3:1 and 655,360–8,294,400 pixels. Above 2560×1440 is experimental.
apimart.referenceHint: Up to 16 public image URLs. Upload PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files up to 20 MB each. Upload links expire after 72 hours; submit before they expire. References enable editing.
apimart.maskHint: Use a transparent PNG under 4 MB, exactly matching the first reference. Fully transparent pixels mark the area to edit. A black-and-white image without alpha is not a mask. Preservation outside the mask is not guaranteed.
apimart.markupHint: Use a separate transparent PNG annotation layer matching the first reference. Do not flatten it into the original. This uploader accepts up to 20 MB; do not combine it with a mask.
apimart.confirmOverlayLabel: I confirm this PNG has transparency and exactly matches the first reference dimensions.
apimart.svgHint: Required for standard SVG. Choose a text model supported by your APIMart account; its text usage is charged separately.
apimart.svgExtHint: Optional for Ext 2.6 SVG. Leave blank to use the provider default.
apimart.textOnlyHint: GIF and SVG support text-to-image only. GIF uses automatic frame size. Remove references and overlays before selecting these formats.
apimart.billingHint: Quality auto may reserve funds at the maximum level for standard models. Higher quality and resolution may take longer. Check your provider account for pricing.
apimart.asyncHint: Submitted once, then checked every 4 seconds for up to 5 minutes. Pausing stops checks, not the provider task.
apimart.pollingHint: Checking the accepted task. No generation request is resubmitted.
apimart.expiryHint: Result URLs are temporary. Download the files promptly; saving history stores links rather than permanent copies.
apimart.unknownHint: Submission could not be confirmed. Check your provider account or enter its task ID above. A new submission may create a second paid task.
apimart.acknowledgeUnknown: I have checked the provider task list and accept the risk of starting another task.
apimart.receiptPending: The provider accepted this task, but its local receipt has not been saved. Recover the receipt to query it; this does not create a new task.
apimart.receiptError: The receipt could not be recovered yet. Keep this page and try recovery again; do not resubmit generation.
apimart.storageWarning: This browser could not preserve the task receipt. Copy the task ID before leaving this page.
apimart.queryError: The task could not be checked. Its ID is preserved; resume checks instead of submitting again.
apimart.pollTimeout: Automatic checks have paused after 5 minutes. The provider task may still be running; resume checks with the same ID.
apimart.submitUnknown: The submission result is uncertain. No automatic generation retry was made.
apimart.submitRejected: The request was rejected before task acceptance. Check your channel, account and settings.
apimart.taskFailed: The provider reported task failure. Check your request and references before explicitly starting another task.
